## Goal
The admin agent can only propose; the owner applies with a 4-digit code or the dashboard; prices need step-up.

## Owns
- `services/tool-api/src/handlers/admin-propose-change.ts`
- `services/tool-api/src/handlers/admin-apply-change.ts`
- `services/tool-api/src/lib/changes.ts`
- `services/tool-api/test/changes.test.ts`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- propose returns a code unique among the tenant's open changes, 30-min TTL, and a one-line human summary.
- apply: owner only; unknown/expired -> 404; price change without valid X-Step-Up-Token -> 428; success emits admin.change_applied and writes audit.
- admin-agent token calling apply -> 403.
